items.quote: which in turn was named after Thomas Brisbane, the British-born governor of New South Wales from 1821 to 1825
items.note: Strictly the city is named after the Brisbane River, which is named after him; the question's framing is fine for a pub round.

items.quote: The Story Bridge is a heritage-listed steel cantilever bridge spanning the Brisbane River
items.note: The new Kangaroo Point Bridge (pedestrian/cycle, cable-stayed) also lands at Kangaroo Point, but "steel cantilever" excludes it.

items.quote: Founded in April 1987, the Broncos compete in the National Rugby League (NRL)
items.note: Rechecked after rewording; 'founded in 1987' excludes the Dolphins (a 1947 club, NRL since 2023). 'Named after a wild horse' is close to a giveaway for anyone who knows the name, acceptable as an easy one.

items.quote: Nicknamed the Maroons after the colour of their jersey
is a stadium located in the Brisbane suburb of Woolloongabba
The 1982 Commonwealth Games were held in Brisbane, Australia
items.note: Watch for "2018": those Games were on the Gold Coast, not Brisbane. Brisbane's 2032 event is the Olympics.

items.quote: The parkland, on the transformed site of Brisbane's World Expo 88
items.note: The question gives "1988", so this is close to a giveaway; accept "Expo 88".

items.quote: the popular children's animated television series Bluey is produced and set in Brisbane

Barry Gibb unveiled a statue of the Bee Gees as well as unveiling "Bee Gees Way" (a walkway filled with photos and videos of the Bee Gees) in honour of the Bee Gees in Redcliffe, Queensland, Australia
All the species of slipper lobsters are edible, and some, such as the Moreton Bay bug and the Balmain bug
items.note: Accept "crustacean"? It is true but less specific; the host should decide. en:Thenus also has "Thenus orientalis is a species of slipper lobster".
